_doc: Map 0 (Crossroads Inn) settings not in the generic tables. power: the cellar lever (T&C M2, T-027). exfil: the campaign beacon (T-033): lights when round `round` starts, stays open window_seconds, then again every retry_rounds rounds; a vote at the beacon leaves for `target` through cutscene `cutscene` (data/gravelight/campaign.json). position/yaw in the map frame (yaw 0 = the beacon's front faces -Z). opens_zone: that zone's doors open for free when the beacon lights, so the exfil is always reachable.

ladders.name: TowerLadder_Foot
ladders._doc: T-229 the Hochsitz; T-230: the body climbs the ladder line 0.4 m off the rungs (line), facing the tower (face, default yaw + 180). T-268: the tower has two stages; this ladder (the north face) ends on the landing, 6.2 m up. T-275: it arrives through a 1 m opening in the landing's north parapet, its stiles carried on 1 m over the deck as hand holds; the climb ends just inside the opening

ladders.name: TowerLadder_Upper
ladders._doc: T-268 the second stage, the landing to the top platform (12 m). T-275: inside the tower, from the landing's floor up through a hatch in the top platform's floor against its east parapet (x 6.45..7.3, z 44.65..45.6); the climber hangs over the hatch facing south and steps off over the ladder's head onto the platform south of it

ladders.name: CellarHatch_Up
ladders.locked_text: The hatch is bolted from above
ladders._doc: T-229: the aunt's ladder under the cellar hatch behind the bar

ziplines.name: YardZip
ziplines.target: across the yard to the hitching rail
ziplines._doc: T-229 the yard's zip line; T-230: hang 2.7 = the rider's feet under the cable with the arms up (the bar is 0.56 under it). T-268: one of three from the top platform's roof posts; this one stays inside the Carters' Yard, landing between the cart and the trough, 7 m from the horse's rail: always usable (24.6 m, 27 degrees)

ziplines.name: InnZip
ziplines.target: north to the passage behind the inn
ziplines.locked_text: The trolley is chained: the grounds are not open
ziplines._doc: T-268: north past the stable's west wall, over the yard's fence, down into the passage between the inn and the stable. The landing is on the grounds, so the line is chained until the grounds are open (the yard's gate or the front door): a zip line never skips a paid door (25.5 m, 26 degrees)

ziplines.name: BankZip
ziplines.target: over the fence to the bank road
ziplines.locked_text: The trolley is chained: the grounds are not open
ziplines._doc: T-268: south-west over the yard's fences to the road by the savings bank's shed. On the grounds: chained until they are open (24.6 m, 27 degrees)

climb_links.name: Climb_Tower
climb_links._doc: T-229: the zombies climb the watchtower's ladder to the landing. T-268: a ladder (line): one at a time up its line, the rest wait at the foot; drop: they come back down it by dropping (ClimbLink). T-275: the head is just inside the landing's parapet opening; perch: the siege shake reaches the landing's corners from it

climb_links.name: Climb_TowerUpper
climb_links._doc: T-268: the second ladder, from the landing to the top platform. T-275: inside the tower, up through the top's hatch (the line over the hatch, the head south of the ladder's head); a body shot on it falls north onto the landing; perch: the siege shake reaches the top's corners

climb_links.name: Climb_CellarHatch
climb_links._doc: T-229: the cellar hatch behind the bar, both ways (down it is a drop)

horses.name: YardHorse
horses._doc: T-240 the carters' Noriker, tied at a hitching rail under the hoist ledge by the stable's south wall (east of the Thompson chalk at x 22, 7.5 m from the yard zip line's landing post (T-268: it moved east of the cart), across the yard from the tower's ladder). yaw 0 = it faces north, toward the rail and the wall. zones: where it may stand (the yard; the grounds once the gate is open): it refuses the stable's door, the inn and the tower. The rail's collider is on the map-edge layer (players are stopped, zombies and shots pass), so the baked navmesh is untouched. Tuning: data/gravelight/horse.json

round_bosses._doc: T-240 the undead horses (data/gravelight/bosses/horse.json; HorseRound). One line per boss round; a map without this block has none
T-249: on the Inn der Fuhrmann leads the round-30 horde that hits the Sherman (sherman_event): he is heard as the tank parks and comes in up the road behind it as the dead go for it

round_boss_arena._doc: T-240 where a horse goes on the Inn: the yard, the grounds and the stable (a 2.0 m door and an open floor); never the taproom, the stairs or the cellar (furniture, a staircase, a hatch). It comes up the carters' road (arrive) and breaks the yard's gate open if it is still chained; a player elsewhere is not chased (the siege rule).

sherman_event._doc: T-249 the Sherman (data/gravelight/sherman.json; ShermanEvent). Round 30: it comes in from beyond the south-east edge along the carters' road (route; it rolls over the sawhorse barrier at the road's exit), parks on the road outside the yard's gate facing it (park, park_yaw from the last leg) and the dead come for it; it covers the yard and the road from there for rounds 31..39 (it never moves into the yard: nothing baked changes, its hull collider is on the map-edge layer); round 40 a dive bomber kills it there and the bombs fall on the yard and the grounds (bomb_zones) while the inn (shelter_zones, inn_box) keeps everyone in it safe. A map without this block has no Sherman.
sherman_event._doc_drive: T-261 where a player may drive the Sherman (ShermanRules.may_stand: every point of the hull's footprint in a drive_zones zone, inside one of the drive_boxes [x0, z0, x1, z1] and outside every drive_no_go disc [x, z, r]): the road and the meadow south of the yard's fence, and the fields east and west of the yard up to the stable's line: a horseshoe round the yard, 12 m wide or more everywhere, so a hull left anywhere in it (or its wreck after round 40) closes no way through. Never the yard, the stable or the inn (z < 20 is out), never past the map's edge; the disc keeps the mouth of the yard's gate clear (the parked hull's bow is 3.4 m from its centre). Nothing baked changes: the navmesh and the dead's paths are as they were.
